reference_sql:
WITH november_starts AS (
  -- one row per session_start event on the Dublin days of November 2025, with its session ID and engaged flag
  SELECT traffic_source.medium AS first_touch_medium,
         user_pseudo_id,
         list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_id')[1].value.int_value AS ga_session_id,
         list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'session_engaged')[1].value.string_value AS session_engaged
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'session_start'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251130'
),
sessions_seen AS (
  -- one row per session, a user_pseudo_id with a ga_session_id; a start with either ID missing is left out
  SELECT first_touch_medium, user_pseudo_id, ga_session_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN session_engaged = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS engaged
  FROM november_starts
  WHERE user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL
    AND ga_session_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY first_touch_medium, user_pseudo_id, ga_session_id
)
SELECT first_touch_medium,
       COUNT(*) AS sessions,
       SUM(engaged) AS engaged_sessions,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(engaged) / COUNT(*), 1) AS engaged_pct
FROM sessions_seen
GROUP BY first_touch_medium
ORDER BY first_touch_medium

WITH november_starts AS (
  -- one row per session_start event on the Dublin days of November 2025 whose visitor and session ID are both there
  SELECT traffic_source.medium AS first_touch_medium,
         user_pseudo_id || '-' || CAST([p.value.int_value FOR p IN event_params IF p.key = 'ga_session_id'][1] AS VARCHAR) AS session_key,
         [p.value.string_value FOR p IN event_params IF p.key = 'session_engaged'][1] AS session_engaged
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'session_start'
    AND event_date >= '20251101'
    AND event_date <= '20251130'
    AND user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL
    AND [p.value.int_value FOR p IN event_params IF p.key = 'ga_session_id'][1] IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT first_touch_medium,
       COUNT(DISTINCT session_key) AS sessions,
       COUNT(DISTINCT session_key) FILTER (WHERE session_engaged = '1') AS engaged_sessions,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT session_key) FILTER (WHERE session_engaged = '1') / COUNT(DISTINCT session_key), 1) AS engaged_pct
FROM november_starts
GROUP BY first_touch_medium
ORDER BY first_touch_medium

WITH november_starts AS (
  -- one row per session_start event of November 2025 that carries a ga_session_id: the comma join keeps one parameter row,
  -- so a consent-denied start, which has no ga_session_id, drops out here
  SELECT e.traffic_source.medium AS first_touch_medium,
         e.user_pseudo_id,
         p.value.int_value AS ga_session_id,
         list_filter(e.event_params, lambda q: q.key = 'session_engaged')[1].value.string_value AS session_engaged
  FROM events AS e, unnest(e.event_params) AS t(p)
  WHERE e.event_name = 'session_start'
    AND e.event_date BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251130'
    AND p.key = 'ga_session_id'
),
sessions_seen AS (
  -- one row per session, a user_pseudo_id with a ga_session_id, engaged or not
  SELECT DISTINCT first_touch_medium, user_pseudo_id, ga_session_id,
         CASE WHEN session_engaged = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS engaged
  FROM november_starts
  WHERE user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT first_touch_medium,
       COUNT(*) AS sessions,
       SUM(engaged) AS engaged_sessions,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(engaged) / COUNT(*), 1) AS engaged_pct
FROM sessions_seen
GROUP BY first_touch_medium
ORDER BY first_touch_medium

solver.query:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT user_pseudo_id, traffic_source.medium AS medium,
         COALESCE(g.int_value, g.float_value, g.double_value) AS sid,
         e.string_value AS eng
  FROM (
    SELECT user_pseudo_id, traffic_source,
           list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_id')[1].value AS g,
           list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'session_engaged')[1].value AS e
    FROM events
    WHERE event_name = 'session_start' AND event_date BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251130'
  )
  WHERE user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL
), ss AS (
  SELECT user_pseudo_id, sid, max(medium) AS medium, max(CASE WHEN eng = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS engaged
  FROM base WHERE sid IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id, sid
)
SELECT medium AS first_touch_medium, count(*) AS sessions, sum(engaged) AS engaged_sessions,
       round(100.0 * sum(engaged) / count(*), 1) AS engaged_pct
FROM ss GROUP BY medium ORDER BY medium
